decision.reason: [ev-c15ec21c6716] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that promtail now correctly parses a YAML list of drop stage sources, and it links to PR #10848 and commit f51ee84 for the details. It does not give the config key or schema field, the earlier wrong behavior (for example, rejected, only partly read, or silently ignored), which configurations were affected (list form versus a single string), or what happens to an affected pipeline. The linked PR or commit diff, or the drop stage documentation, is needed to settle the subject, applicability and consequence.
